# docker_image_history (Data Source)

Reads the layer history of a local image, like `docker image history` (`GET /images/{name}/history`). Entries come newest first, as the daemon returns them; each one is the instruction that created a layer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Layer history of a local image, newest layer first (docker image history).
data "docker_image_history" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx:1.27"
}

output "nginx_layers" {
  value = [for h in data.docker_image_history.nginx.history : h.created_by]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Image name, tag or ID, e.g. `nginx:1.27`.

### Optional

- `platform` (String) Platform of a multi-platform image to read, `os[/arch[/variant]]`. Default: the daemon's platform. Needs API 1.48+ (containerd image store).

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of history_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `history` (Attributes List) The GET /images/{name}/history response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))
- `history_json` (String, Sensitive) The Engine API GET /images/{name}/history response as JSON; layers in the Engine's order (newest first). Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact).
- `id` (String) ID of the image (the first history entry).

<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Upstream `Comment`.
- `created` (Number) Upstream `Created`.
- `created_by` (String, Sensitive) Upstream `CreatedBy`. Sensitive.
- `id` (String) Upstream `Id`.
- `size` (Number) Upstream `Size`.
- `tags` (List of String) Upstream `Tags`.
